sn45.69:0.3: Accomplishment in Rational Application of Mind (1st)
sn45.69:1.2: A meditator accomplished in wise attention can expect to develop and cultivate the noble eightfold path.
sn45.69:1.3: And how does a meditator accomplished in wise attention develop and cultivate the noble eightfold path?
sn45.69:1.4: It’s when a meditator develops right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right {{concentration}}, which rely on seclusion, fading away, and cessation, and ripen as letting go.
sn45.69:1.5: That’s how a meditator accomplished in wise attention develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path.”
